subject: Error in methylation calling, sorting and legitimate Bismark SAM file

messages.author: 071f335069d94693
messages.subject: Error in methylation calling, sorting and legitimate Bismark SAM file
parts:
Hello, 

I've looked throughout this forum and noticed that several people have received the same error as me but I still cannot find a way to fix the issue. After I convert my bam from bismark into a sam and sort it (via samtools for both steps) I get the error below: 

file.list=list("LCH-025-B.sorted2_M.sam", "LCH-026-B.sorted2_M.sam")
myobj=read.bismark(file.list,
            sample.id=list("normal", "tumour"),assembly="hg18",treatment=c(0,1))

Error in .local(location, sample.id, assembly, save.folder, save.context,  : 

  

Error in methylation calling...

Make sure the file is sorted correctly and it is a legitimate Bismark SAM file


I cannot find a way to solve this. 

I've tried removing the header like some have suggested and I've even tried removing chrM and I still receive the same error. 

The first few columns of my sam files look like this: 


NB501085:3:H533NAFXX:1:11107:9068:18097_1:N:0:CGACACAC  163     chr1    13361   30      151M    =       13393   183     ACTACTGTATAAAAATTCACTCCTACCTTTTCCTTTCCCTAAAACCTCCACCACCCCGAAATCACATTTCTCACTACCTTTTATCTACCCAATTTCACCAAAAATAGACCTCTTCCTAACAAACAACTACACCACTACCTAACGCTATACC 

NB501085:3:H533NAFXX:1:11107:9068:18097_1:N:0:CGACACAC  83      chr1    13393   30      151M    =       13361   -183    CTTTCCCTAAAACCTCCACCACCCCGAAATCACATTTCTCACTACCTTTTATCTACCCAATTTCACCAAAAATAGACCTCTTCCTAACAAACAACTACACCACTACCTAACGCTATACCCTTCCTTTACTCTACCCGCTAAAAACGATATT 

NB501085:3:H533NAFXX:4:21503:24229:14526_1:N:0:CGACACAC 99      chr1    14682   30      151M    =       14729   198     TGTTATGGAGTTTTTTACGATTTTTAGTCGTTTTCGTTTTTTTTTGTTTGTGGTTGTTGCGGTGGCGGTAGAGGAGGGATGGAGTTTGATACGCGGGTAAAGGTTTTTTCGGGTTTTTTATTAGTTTTAGGTTTTTTTTTAGAGATGTTTG 

NB501085:3:H533NAFXX:4:21503:24229:14526_1:N:0:CGACACAC 147     chr1    14729   30      151M    =       14682   -198    TTGTGGTTGTTGCGGTGGCGGTAGAGGAGGGATGGAGTTTGATACGCGGGTAAAGGTTTTTTCGGGTTTTTTATTAGTTTTAGGTTTTTTTTTAGAGATGTTTGGAGGGAAAAGGTTGAGTGAGGGTGGTTGGTGGGAAATTTTGGTTTTT 


Any guidance on what to do next would be greatly beneficial. I'd really like to use this tool! 

Leslie

messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Error in methylation calling, sorting and legitimate Bismark SAM file
parts:
please make sure your sam file conforms to the example shown here:
https://github.com/al2na/methylKit/blob/master/inst/extdata/test.fastq_bismark.sorted.min.sam

also described in the bismark manual
http://www.bioinformatics.babraham.ac.uk/projects/bismark/Bismark_User_Guide.pdf

your columns are scrambled and the script can not find the methylation call string from bismark where it should be. In addition, you have too few reads to call methylation. This could be because of the way you subsampled. There are no overlapping reads, you won't be able to get reliable methylation calls out of this even if you fix the issue with the file format.

Best,
Altuna
